body.segment: Two examples of confined molecular catalysts are presented.
PtCl42- complexes are attached to a thiol-terminated monolayer by ligand exchange of Cl- with a thiolate group and incorporated in a multilayer of viologen moieties by ion exchange.
All Cl- ligands are replaced by OH- or H2O before HER takes place.
Ex situ and in situ XAFS measurements confirm that the Pt complexes accelerate HER without being converted into Pt particles.
